Vendor/IrohBridge.xcframework is MediaStorm's iroh-bridge library, built from Rust.
It statically links the following open-source crates, each under its own licence.
Source for every crate is available at https://crates.io/crates/<name>/<version>;
netdev and netwatch carry small patches adding tvOS to their iOS-only cfg gates.
